lines.text: In my setup, agents do real, everyday work.
Some answer users in the support chat.
Another one sums up what users ask for most.
One knows what was shipped, and updates the knowledge base.
Another reads the meeting notes, and puts everything there too.
Some jobs watch the competitors. Others watch the logs.
It's a swarm. And all of it runs through one orchestrator.
And me? I only look at the summaries and the charts.
